title: Do Proprietary Costs Deter Insider Trading?
authors: Lyungmae Choi; Lucile Faurel; Stephen A. Hillegeist
eligible_reason: The headline analysis is a cross-sectional Tobit of insider purchases (buy5) on a continuous composite proprietary-cost measure. The only staggered element is Table 5: state-level changes in noncompete enforceability, coded as a SIGNED indicator nce_inc (+1 after increases in CO 1992, ID 1992, OH 1992, FL 1997, GA 2005, HI 2007, KS 2008, MS 2009; -1 after decreases in CT 1992, TX 1995). It is estimated only by Tobit (tobit2, two-way clustered by state and year) with firm-level time-varying controls and year, NAICS3-industry and state dummies (no firm FE). Col 2 uses a three-state signed version (LA -1 2002, FL +1 1997, TX -1 1995), col 3 a single-state Texas 1995 dummy (one cohort), col 4 adds a LocalRival interaction. Signed/bidirectional treatment, nonlinear model, extra additive industry FE and time-varying controls all violate the rules; no linear TWFE counterpart is reported.
design_notes: Data regdata.dta (firm-year, 135,722 rows, 1986-2017; Table 5 sample 1986-2013, drops LA/VA/WV in cols 1 and 4). Table 3/7/8: tobit2 buy5 proprietary + controls (log_lagmktcap lag_bm preret12 nanalyst io_perc lag_turnover lag_litrisk lag_volatility shrown_f4_fill5 lag_baspread) + year (D*) and industry (I*) dummies. Table 4: OLS of insider-trade abnormal returns on proprietary with controls. Table 6: Tobit of buy5 on pre-product-launch window indicators pp12/pp11 vs non-launch firm-years (event-driven, not a panel DiD). Table 9: reghdfe invt on c.mtb##c.buy5 and rival analogues with firm and year FE (continuous interactions, no treatment timing).
estimators_reported: OLS cross-sectional with year and industry dummies
reghdfe firm+year FE with continuous interactions (Table 9)
main_or_robustness: secondary setting (noncompete-enforceability changes are one of two supplementary 'exogenous variation' tests; headline is cross-sectional)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Enforceability changes in 1992 (CO, CT, ID, OH), 1995 (TX), 1997 (FL), 2005 (GA), 2007 (HI), 2008 (KS), 2009 (MS), but with mixed signs (+1/-1), verified in regdata.dta.

specs.exclusion_reason: Tobit (nonlinear); signed +1/-1 treatment (increases and decreases); state, industry and year dummies without firm FE (extra additive industry FE); time-varying firm controls
specs.controls: log_lagmktcap lag_bm preret12 nanalyst io_perc lag_turnover lag_litrisk lag_volatility shrown_f4_fill5 lag_baspread
specs.sample_condition: fyear 1986-2013; drop LA VA WV; drop thin fyear-state and naics3 cells
specs.notes: cols 2 (nce_inc_big, line 315), 3 (texas, line 331, single cohort 1995, 1992-1996), 4 (LocalRival interaction, line 346) share the structure

specs.exclusion_reason: no DiD design: continuous proprietary-cost regressor in a Tobit

data_access: public (regression-ready datasets shipped; underlying Compustat/CRSP/Thomson insider/IBES data are licensed)
software: stata (tobit2/cluster2 Petersen ado files, reghdfe); SAS for data construction
screener_notes: Article text not available; table mapping from do-file headers and Readme.pdf. Treatment coding verified in regdata.dta: nce_inc takes values -1/0/1 with states switching once in one direction. A binary-increase-only TWFE with firm and year FE could be constructed from the shipped data but is not reported.
